info.long_name: Medicaid and CHIP Preventative Services Rate
info.short_description: Percentage of Medicaid and CHIP beneficiaries who received preventative services.
info.long_description: State-level preventative services rates for Medicaid and CHIP beneficiaries, from the Medicaid and CHIP Adult Core Set Quality Measures voluntarily reported by states to CMS (2014–2023). Includes flu vaccinations for adults (FVA: percent of adults who received an influenza vaccination during the flu season), chlamydia screening in women (CHL: percent of sexually active adult women screened for chlamydia), diabetes screening via HbA1c testing (HA1C: percent of adults with diabetes who received an HbA1c test), antidepressant medication management (AMM: percent of adults with a new diagnosis of depression who remained on antidepressant medication), and controlling high blood pressure (CBP: percent of adults with hypertension whose blood pressure was adequately controlled). Reporting is voluntary; not all states report all measures each year.
